name: offer-desk.attention-triage
purpose: Shortlist offer board rows that deterministically warrant attention, then label only that shortlist with one batched classification call.

max_items.description: Maximum shortlist size sent for classification, 1 to 40.

assumptions: The board's status and rank_reason are authoritative; this program does not re-rank.
gates-proposals returns no selectable rows when there are no open proposals; that is read as zero, not as a failed read.
invariants: The shortlist is deterministic and is reported whether or not classification succeeds.
At most one inference call is made, and none when the shortlist is empty.
An abstained row is reported as abstained; it is never given a default label.

bindings.note: Optional: a failed read degrades this program to partial and the shortlist still reports.

signals.shortlist: Deterministically selected rows, each naming why_candidate.
signals.labelled: One row per shortlist item with its label or abstained true.
signals.triage_reason: no_candidate when the board is quiet, classification_unavailable when the batch call failed.
signals.inference_calls: 0 or 1; never one call per row.
signals.usage: The batch call's reported token usage.
signals.open_proposals: Count of open promotion proposals, or null when the proposal read genuinely failed.

outputs.evidence: Board, proposal and inference binding ids.

budget.async_reason: One batched classification over up to forty rows can exceed the synchronous submission bound.

fixtures.note: Out-of-range input is invalid_input, never partial.
Refused when inference spend is withheld; the deterministic shortlist still reports.
